newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen firming on Dow's rebound.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen firming on Dow's rebound.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are expected to gain ground on Tuesday with participants encouraged by the rebound in New York overnight and the dollar's rise against the yen, brokers said.
On Monday, the Nikkei 225 average finished down 284.93 points or 1.47 percent at 19,041.10. Nikkei September futures fell 440 points to 19,000.

"As Nikkei 225 futures in Chicago ended firmly overnight, the futures in Osaka will likely rise this morning and prompt arbitrageurs to buy cash stocks," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities.

But Ueki also said market sentiment remains generally cautious amid concerns about lingering weakness in the Japanese economy and the possibility that companies may revise their earnings forecasts downward.

A market analyst at a foreign brokerage said many players will likely take a wait-and-see stance on Tuesday as they wait for announcements of several items of U.S. economic data scheduled for later this week.
Market sources predicted trade will range between 18,900 and 19,400 on the Nikkei 225.
